text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 high error rate for inference endpoints in eu-west-2a (AZ eu-west-2a). Alerts: 5xx spike + sustained token generation timeouts across G5 pools.
carla_oncall: I'm on it. seeing a jump in 5xx and connection errors to GPU nodes. linking logs: https://internal-log/trace/1912345999 :shock:
ben_runtime: Can you paste the log snippets? I'm pulling serving metrics.
carla_oncall: snippet: ```2026-03-15T11:06:10Z ERROR serve: stream: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
2026-03-15T11:06:11Z WARN runtime: failed to attach kvcache to session id=xyz```
frank_net: I’m seeing increased ENI flaps in eu-west-2a in the cloud console for the g5 instance class. AWS console shows packet drops and ENI attach/detach events for a subset of hosts (host-id i-0abcde...).
ben_runtime: That explains the reset errors. Are we hitting a zonal networking degradation or underlying host failures?
frank_net: Likely zonal network plane issues affecting a small cluster of hosts. Cross-checking with provider incidents; not public yet.
carla_oncall: Customer impact: ~18% of requests to eu-west-2 are getting 5xx, and latency p90 for generation increased from 120ms to 1.2s. Several paying customers reported timeouts. Eva, heads up for CS.
eva_cs: Noted. I'll open a quick incident message to impacted accounts and escalate if SLA at risk. Any ETA on mitigation?
ben_runtime: Short-term mitigation: mark affected pool as degraded and route traffic to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 fallback pools. I can flip routing policy but need approvals and capacity check.
dan_product: We prefer rolling fallback to avoid cold-start capacity shocks. Also check model-variant parity for consistent behavior.
carla_oncall: @sre-rotation can you run a capacity check for fallback regions for the next 15m? use: ```./tools/capacity-check --region eu-west-1,eu-central-1 --req 10k```
sre-rotation: Running now. Preliminary: eu-central-1 has cushion for embeddings/generation small models but limited G5 spare capacity for large models. eu-west-1 has more free nodes.
deploy-bot: AUTO: Deployment event: canary routing policy change requested by ben_runtime at 11:12Z. Requires two approvals.
ben_runtime: I'll start a partial reroute of 25% traffic off eu-west-2 to eu-west-1 now and monitor error rates. If stable for 5m, ramp to 75%.
carla_oncall: Do it. Also set circuit-breaker to reduce retries to 1 to reduce load on failing hosts: config path `/routes/inference/*` param `retry_count=1`.
ben_runtime: Executed: ```rbctl route update --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --pct 25 --circuit-breaker retry_count=1```
ben_runtime: Monitoring metrics... error rate in eu-west-2 dropped from 18% -> 13% within 60s. Traffic on eu-west-1 p90 latency up 20% but requests succeeding.
frank_net: FYI I'm opening a support case with AWS for ENI flaps and packet drops in eu-west-2a (case 987654321). Posting response when available.
carla_oncall: Can we proactively cordon the affected instances / drain inference pods from suspected noisy hosts to prevent further resets?
ben_runtime: We can't fully cordon at AZ level without losing capacity; I'll drain the specific host instances that show ENI instability. Running: ```kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
ben_runtime: Drains started. Deploy-bot: rolling drain/scheduler pause in progress.
carla_oncall: handoff: ben_runtime will be incident lead for next 30m. I'll update the incident bridge and notify execs.
ben_runtime: Taking lead. Plan: 1) continue partial reroute -> 2) drain noisy hosts -> 3) if ENI flaps persist, expand fallback to 60-75% and enable longer-term autoscale in eu-west-1.
eva_cs: Sent status to impacted customers: short note that we're mitigating and routing traffic to nearby regions; asked them to report continued errors.
frank_net: AWS responded: suspected fabric issue isolated to subset of hardware in eu-west-2a, remediation ETA 2-4 hours. They recommended routing traffic away from affected instances.
ben_runtime: Given AWS ETA, we're going to fully ramp to 70% offload in 10m and keep 30% to allow quick failback when fabric is fixed. Executing: ```rbctl route update --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --pct 70```
ben_runtime: Update: error rate in eu-west-2 now down to 4%, overall global error rate back to baseline. Latency still slightly elevated but within SLO for most customers.
carla_oncall: Great. I'm updating postmortem starter and tagging for follow-up: network/hardware tagging, add more robust per-AZ capacity steering in routing rules.
dan_product: Add a note to evaluate automatic cross-AZ warm pools for critical customers to avoid single-AZ exposures.
sre-rotation: I'll add a follow-up runbook task: pre-warm fallback pools when health signals show AZ instability.
carla_oncall: handoff complete to ben_runtime at 11:45Z, ben will keep monitoring. If anything regresses, page the oncall rotation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ben_runtime: Monitoring. Closing active mitigation updates, will post final resolution when AWS confirms fix and we fully failback.
incident-bot: Incident log appended: 1912345999. Severity: P1 -> ongoing. Tags: az, eniflap, fallback, oncall-handoff.
